book: Benedicti Aretii Bernensis theologi Lectiones septem de Cœna Domini (Morges, Ioannes le Preux, 1581): seven numbered lectures on the Lord's Supper, each on a scriptural passage and divided into numbered or titled subsections, preceded by a front-matter index of the lectures and an effigy, and ending with FINIS.
